item.title: Health & Wellness Product Review Writer
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m launching a health and wellness blog that will focus exclusively on product reviews. I already have a curated list of supplements, fitness gadgets, and self-care items I want covered; you’ll work from that list and expand it only after we discuss new additions.
Your job is to research each item thoroughly, test or investigate user experiences where possible, and craft clear, engaging review posts that balance evidence-based insight with an approachable tone. Readers should finish each article knowing exactly what the product does, who it’s best for, any pros or cons, and whether it’s worth their money.
The writing needs to be original, SEO-friendly (keywords provided per product), and formatted for easy reading on WordPress. Please include sources for claims, disclose any potential biases, and suggest photos or diagrams when useful.

item.title: High converting landing page & digital promotion for workshop in London
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need a premium, high-converting landing page and a short burst of digital promotion for my upcoming one-day workshop in London. The page’s sole purpose is to promote the event and turn visitors into paid attendees, so every design and copy choice should drive that outcome. All creative assets must reflect precision and luxury positioning to attract high-performing professionals.
Core page requirements • A fast-loading, highly responsive mobile-first build on WordPress. • Clear, persuasive copy that highlights the value of the day, reinforced by a real-time countdown timer to build urgency • A succinct workshop agenda section so prospects instantly see what they’ll learn • A seamless registration flow securely connected to our payment processor and integrated with an automated email platform. • Complete meta tags, open-graph images, and optimized on-page SEO so the page displays beautifully across social sharing platforms.
Digital Promotion & Campaign Burst Drive traffic through two core channels, and provide complete creative and technical setup:
* Social Media Track (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook): You will deliver high-end campaign artwork that matches the landing page aesthetic (sophisticated corporate palette: navy, slate grey, charcoal) along with ad copy variations. * Automated Email Track: You will write and set up the automated email drip sequence mapping out the full consumer journey: Initial Interest ➔ Urgency Reminders ➔ Registration Confirmation ➔ Pre-Participation Logistics ➔ Post-Event Follow-up. * Strategic Launch Advisory: Clear, actionable advice on audience targeting parameters, scheduling, and custom lookalike sets so the campaign can be launched without guesswork.
Acceptance Criteria
1. Speed Baseline: The WordPress landing page must load in under 2 seconds on mobile devices, achieving a Google Lighthouse performance score of ≥ 90. 2. Cross-Platform Rendering: The countdown timer, booking widget, and agenda layout must render flawlessly on Chrome, Safari, and Edge across both desktop and mobile viewports. 3. Asset Delivery: All social media graphics, ad variants, and email copies must be delivered as clean, editable source files, accompanied by a simple launch sheet outlining recommended deployment dates, spend brackets, and key KPIs to monitor. 4. Timeline: This system must be fully built, tested, and ready to go live within 5 days of award.

item.title: Senior Lead for WordPress Business Platform
item.description: 5000-10000 GBP | Yes. I’d advertise this as a senior delivery-team / technical lead opportunity, not a cheap generic WordPress job. You want applicants who can demonstrate they have already delivered this type of platform and understand the entire lifecycle from discovery through launch and support. Strong applicants should have demonstrable experience in several of the following: WordPress development • custom themes/plugins • PHP • JavaScript • REST APIs • HubSpot integrations • CRM integrations • advanced search • user accounts • accessibility/WCAG • cybersecurity • performance optimisation • cloud/managed hosting • automated backups • Git/version control • staging/production environments • QA/testing. Experience delivering websites for government, local authorities, public-sector organisations, business-support organisations, universities, membership organisations or other large organisations would be particularly valuable. VERY IMPORTANT – your application Please do not send a generic proposal. We are selecting the proposed technical team partly on the strength of their previous experience. Therefore, your application must provide evidence of work you personally/your team have delivered. Please include: 1. Your name, location and role. 2. Years of professional web-development experience. 3. Whether you are an individual developer or an established team/company. 4. item.title: Cartoon Graphic Novel With Website

item.title: Shopping Mall Management System
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I am ready to commission a complete, web-based management suite for a multi-store shopping mall. The project must cover two distinct areas:
1. A mall-level administration panel that tracks tenants, leases, foot-traffic analytics, promotions, and finance. 2. A store-level back office where each retailer can handle day-to-day tasks such as product catalogues, inventory, staff rosters, and sales reporting.
Every screen has already been drafted; page 3 of the attachment contains the reference mock-ups that must be followed pixel-for-pixel while remaining fully responsive for desktop and large-tablet browsers.
Key scope elements • Build a single-page web application that communicates with a secure REST (or GraphQL) API. • Design and implement the database schema, access layer, and business logic for tenants, POS feeds, billing, workforce management, and alerting. • Role-based access for mall management, individual store owners, and store staff, each with tailored permissions. • Real-time dashboards for inventory levels, sales analytics, and lease renewals, plus a content area so administrators can publish news and digital-signage playlists without touching code.
Technology expectations I am open to popular stacks such as React or Vue with Node.js, Laravel, or ASP.NET Core—as long as the code is modular, clearly commented, and delivered through Git. Please list any third-party libraries you intend to integrate (charts, authentication, UI kits).
Acceptance criteria • All pages replicate the supplied design guide exactly. • Initial load time <2 seconds on standard broadband. • Unit and integration tests for critical flows. • Final hand-off includes full source code, database scripts, documentation, and a one-command local setup.
Propose a phased timeline with milestone reviews (framework scaffold, data layer, role management, final polish). I prefer to collaborate via Jira or Trello and meet on Zoom twice a week. If anything in the page 3 references is unclear, let’s clarify before development begins.

item.title: Wix Non-Profit Membership Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I run a small, volunteer-led non-profit and we’re ready for a modern website that helps us serve members, share information, and accept payments without adding technical overhead. The entire build must live on Wix so that our team can safely handle routine edits once the project wraps up.
Core functions • Membership management – secure registration, individual log-in, and profile editing. • Member directory – searchable for logged-in members only. • Member communication tools – broadcast emails and in-dashboard notices that route through our existing domain’s email service. • Fundraising and fee collection – seamless checkout powered by Zeffy’s payment widgets, visible both to members (dues) and the public (donations or event tickets). • Informational pages – clear sections for our mission, events, resources, and a news/blog area we can update ourselves.
Integration requirements The Zeffy payment flow, domain-based email management, and all Wix-native CRM features must work together smoothly. Please configure DNS, SSL, and any necessary Wix Marketplace apps so everything functions from day one.
Deliverables 1. Fully designed, responsive Wix site with the features above, ready for launch. 2. Step-by-step admin guide (text or short screencasts) showing how our volunteers can edit pages, approve new members, and pull email lists. 3. One live walkthrough call to verify every element—registration, directory search, Zeffy checkout, and email sends—operates as intended.
Success is a launch-ready site we can confidently maintain ourselves, with no coding knowledge required. If you have previous Wix builds that include member portals or Zeffy integrations, those examples will help me choose quickly.

item.title: Modern WordPress Restaurant Reservations
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to launch a modern, sleek WordPress website that lets guests book a table with zero friction. The entire build should focus on online reservations as the core journey.
Key reservation flow • Interactive date & time picker that blocks out unavailable slots in real-time • Visual table selection so diners choose where they sit • A “Special requests” field captured with each booking and stored in the back-end
Look & feel Clean lines, bold imagery, subtle animations—think contemporary rather than rustic or classic. The site must be fully responsive and load quickly on mobile, as most bookings come through phones.
Pages & functionality – Landing page with enticing hero section, short story of the restaurant, and a prominent “Reserve Now” CTA. – Dedicated reservation page implementing the features above, preferably with a well-supported WordPress booking plugin (e.g., OpenTable widget, Bookly, or your recommended alternative). – Simple menu and events sections are nice to have later, but the launch version can defer them; the reservation funnel must be flawless first. – Contact/Map footer plus basic GDPR-friendly cookie notice.
Deliverables 1. Complete WordPress site installed on my hosting, SSL ready. 2. Custom-styled reservation form matching the brand palette. 3. Admin guide (PDF or short Loom video) showing how I can change availability, tables, and view special requests. 4. One round of revisions after initial hand-off to fine-tune UX.
Acceptance criteria • A test reservation from homepage to confirmation email works end-to-end on desktop and mobile. • Table layout, date & time picker, and special requests field all save correctly in WordPress. • PageSpeed Insight mobile score ≥ 85.
If this brief matches your expertise, please share a link to at least one live restaurant or hospitality site you’ve built with similar booking functionality.

item.title: Restaurant Online Ordering Website

item.title: Building Pharma Supply Chain Web Platform
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | # Pharmaceutical Supply Chain & Traceability Web Platform
## Project Overview
We are looking for an experienced full-stack developer or small development team to build a modern, secure, and responsive web platform for pharmaceutical supply chain management and product traceability.
The platform will provide end-to-end visibility of medicines as they move through the supply chain, from manufacturers to pharmacies and ultimately to consumers. The system will support product identification, ownership transfers, verification, audit history, and regulatory workflows.
This is intended to be a long-term product development engagement, with an initial MVP estimated at approximately 4–6 months.
## MVP Requirements
The initial version should include:
* User authentication and role-based access * Government/regulatory authority management * Drug registration and licensing * Medicine registration and unique identification * End-to-end product traceability * Ownership/custody transfer management * Manufacturer and pharmacy workflows * Audit trails and activity history * Medicine authenticity verification * Public verification portal * Responsive dashboards and interfaces * Backend APIs and database * Security and access controls
## Technical Requirements
Candidates should have strong experience with:
* Full-stack web application development * React, Vue, or similar modern frontend frameworks * TypeScript / JavaScript * Node.js, Go, or similar backend technologies * PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases * REST API development * Authentication and authorization * Cloud infrastructure and deployment * CI/CD and DevOps * Automated testing and QA * Secure application development
Experience with healthcare, pharmaceutical, supply-chain, inventory, traceability, or regulatory software is a strong advantage.
## Integrations & Future Scalability
The architecture should be designed to support future integrations with external systems used by manufacturers, pharmacies, wholesalers, and other supply-chain participants.
Experience with ERP/WMS integrations, EDI, GS1, EPCIS, healthcare APIs, or other enterprise integrations is valuable.
## UI/UX
The platform should have a clean, modern, responsive interface that works well across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Different user roles will require different dashboards and workflows, while the public verification portal should remain simple and easy to use.
## Blockchain
Blockchain is not required for the MVP. We are open to the development partner's technical recommendations regarding whether it would provide meaningful value for any future component.
## Expected Deliverables
The selected partner will be responsible for:
* UI/UX implementation * Frontend development * Backend development * Database implementation * API development * Authentication and authorization * Testing and QA * Cloud deployment * Technical documentation * Source-code delivery and repository handover * Initial post-launch support
## Timeline
The initial MVP is expected to take approximately 4–6 months.
We welcome candidates who can provide a detailed development schedule with milestones and deliverables.
## Ideal Candidate
We are looking for a developer or team that can act as a technology partner, not simply execute isolated development tasks.
Please include:
1. Relevant project experience 2. Examples of similar platforms you have built 3. Proposed technology stack 4. Team composition 5. Estimated timeline 6. Estimated project cost 7. Availability for a 4–6 month engagement 8. Experience with API/enterprise integrations 9. Approach to security and QA 10. Post-MVP support availability
Detailed project documentation will be provided to qualified candidates during the evaluation process.
We are particularly interested in partners who can contribute technical expertise, architectural guidance, and practical recommendations throughout the development process.

item.title: B2B LinkedIn Audience Development & Business Development Specialist
item.description:
8-15 AUD/hr | B2B LinkedIn Audience Development & Business Development Specialist
We are a small Australian business advisory business working with CEOs, business owners and leadership teams of mid-market companies.
We are looking for an experienced B2B LinkedIn specialist to help us build the right executive audience, increase meaningful engagement and identify potential business opportunities.
We will create and supply all LinkedIn content, posts and visuals. This role is NOT content creation.
Scope The freelancer will be responsible for: • Identifying target companies that fit our ideal client profile. • Identifying CEOs, Managing Directors, Founders, Owners, COOs and other relevant senior executives. • Systematically developing a high-quality LinkedIn network. • Identifying relevant people for us to follow and engage with. • Monitoring target executives' LinkedIn activity and identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement. • Tracking executives who regularly engage with our content. • Identifying potential prospects and warm opportunities. • Monitoring business trigger events such as growth, acquisitions, new CEOs, expansion, restructuring and ownership changes. • Identifying potential referral partners including accountants, lawyers, M&A advisers, bankers, board members and executive recruiters. • Maintaining a simple prospect/relationship database. • Providing a concise monthly report covering audience growth, quality of engagement, prospects, conversations and potential opportunities. • Participating in a monthly review to recommend where we should focus next.
Target Market Primarily Australian mid-market companies, typically $20m–$500m+ revenue and 50–500+ employees, particularly in:
Construction & Property | Architecture & Engineering | Manufacturing & Industrial | Transport & Logistics | Professional Services | Financial Services | Technology/SaaS | Energy & Resources
Initial geographic focus is Brisbane/Queensland, followed by Sydney, Melbourne and broader Australia.
Who We're Looking For You should have demonstrated experience in: • B2B LinkedIn audience development. • Targeting CEOs and senior executives. • LinkedIn prospect research. • Relationship-based business development. • LinkedIn Sales Navigator. • Account-based prospecting. • LinkedIn analytics and reporting.
We are not interested in mass connection requests, automated DMs, purchased followers or spam-style lead generation.
Quality of audience and relationships is far more important than follower numbers.
Initial Engagement We propose starting with a 90-day pilot, with the opportunity for an ongoing engagement if successful.
Please provide: 1. Examples of similar B2B LinkedIn work. 2. Your proposed approach. 3. Tools you use, including Sales Navigator. 4. Approximate hours per week. 5. Monthly fee. 6. Results you have achieved with executive/B2B audiences.
Most Important We are looking for someone who understands that the objective isn't simply to generate LinkedIn activity.
The objective is to get us in front of the right CEOs and business owners, build genuine professional relationships and ultimately create qualified business conversations.

This includes, where applicable: - Website files - Source code - Design/source files - Domain - Hosting account - CMS administrator access - Google Analytics - Google Search Console - Advertising/tracking accounts - Graphics and website assets - Any custom code developed for the project We do not want to be locked into a proprietary system that can only be controlled by the developer. item.title: Professional Service Sales Website Build
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | I need a clean, responsive website whose main job is to sell my services online. The look should be modern and trustworthy, but kept simple so visitors can find what they need and move smoothly by browsing
Core pages will include a homepage that introduces, an about section with images, and a contact page. No need for online booking or payment.
The design has to work flawlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Fast load times, basic on-page SEO setup, and accessibility considerations are part of the brief. I would like the site built on a well-supported CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or similar) even Wix or Squarespace so I can update text, images, and service details without touching code after launch.
Deliverables • Fully responsive, launch-ready website with services • Admin dashboard tutorial so I can manage future updates • Two rounds of revisions after the first working draft
I will provide brand colors, copy, and images; you handle the rest—from layout and UI decisions to any necessary plug-ins or integrations. If you can demonstrate previous work where the primary goal was selling services, I’ll prioritize that.

item.title: Webflow UX Overhaul & Integrations
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | I want to take my current Webflow site well beyond a simple template refresh. The primary objective is to improve user experience from the first fold to the checkout/contact point, while giving every page new, on-brand imagery and graphics that feel cohesive and modern.
Here’s the scope:
• Complete visual redesign directly in Webflow, including new graphic assets that match our updated look and feel. • Custom interactive elements—think subtle micro-animations, scroll-triggered reveals, and dynamic content blocks—that keep visitors engaged without slowing the site. • Seamless third-party integrations (CRM, marketing automation, analytics, payment or booking tools as needed) using Webflow’s embed capabilities or custom JavaScript when Webflow’s native options fall short. • Clean, maintainable code injections (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) documented so the in-house team can tweak things later. • Responsive optimisation and cross-browser checks to ensure the new experience is flawless on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Acceptance will be based on: 1. Observable UX improvements validated through a brief pre-/post-launch usability test. 2. All graphics delivered in WebP/SVG where appropriate and compressed for performance. 3. Interactive components functioning smoothly in the published Webflow environment with no console errors. 4. Third-party integrations authenticated and passing data correctly.
I’ll provide full access to the current project, brand guidelines, and any API keys you need. Looking forward to a polished, lightning-fast site that feels intuitive and visually striking.

item.title: E-Commerce Assistant for Batteries
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I run a BigCommerce store that specializes in lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO₄) batteries, along with complementary battery accessories and a growing line of portable solar panels. I’m now looking for a detail-oriented assistant who already feels at home inside BigCommerce and understands the nuances of selling technical, safety-critical products online.
Your day-to-day work will revolve around keeping the storefront accurate, responsive, and conversion-ready. That means staying on top of product data, inventory status, basic order processing, and first-touch customer queries so nothing falls through the cracks. Because our catalog contains batteries and related gear, accuracy in specifications and shipping compliance is essential.
Success here is simple: the catalogue stays current, orders flow without delay, and customers get clear, timely answers. If you’ve previously managed or assisted a BigCommerce shop—especially in electronics or energy storage—you’ll ramp up quickly. Familiarity with LiFePO₄ terminology, watt-hour calculations, or shipping regulations for batteries is a definite plus.
Let me know about your BigCommerce experience, any battery-related projects you’ve handled, and how soon you could start keeping our store in top shape.

item.title: Multi-Vendor Marketplace Development
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m launching a full-scale online marketplace where third-party sellers can register, create storefronts, and manage their own catalogue, while shoppers enjoy a smooth end-to-end buying experience. The frontend needs to be built in Angular or React, and I’d like the backend engineered with either Java (Spring Boot) or C# (ASP.NET Core)—whichever you feel will deliver the best performance, security, and maintainability.
Core scope The project covers everything from architecture to deployment: account creation for vendors and customers, product and inventory management, search and filtering, shopping cart, order life-cycle tracking, and a flexible payment module. I have not settled on a specific gateway yet, so I’m open to your recommendation and subsequent integration. Clean RESTful APIs, solid unit and integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines are expected as part of the workflow.
Key deliverables • React single-page application with responsive design • Secure authentication & role-based access (vendor, buyer, admin) • Backend services in Java or C#, fully documented • Payment gateway integration of our agreed choice • Postman or Swagger documentation for every endpoint • Deployment scripts/Docker files for cloud readiness
Acceptance criteria will revolve around feature completeness, code quality, test coverage, and a successful end-to-end demo on a staging environment.
If you’re comfortable owning the stack from database schema to front-end polish, let’s get started—I’m ready to review your approach and timeline.

item.title: Startup Online Ads Specialist
item.description:
100-350 GBP/hr | I'm looking for an experienced digital marketer to create and manage search engine ads to boost my startup's online presence. The primary platform will be Google, but I'm also interested in ads on ChatGPT and various social media channels. This could also be on a monthly hire basis
Key Tasks: - Design and execute targeted search engine ad campaigns - Manage and optimize ads across Google, ChatGPT, and social media - Provide regular performance reports and insights - Adjust strategies based on analytics and feedback
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proven experience in managing search engine ads, particularly on Google - Familiarity with ChatGPT ad placements - Strong background in social media advertising - Excellent analytical skills to measure and improve ad performance - Creative mindset to design engaging ad content
Please include examples of previous successful campaigns in your bids.

item.title: Multisite Car Posting CRM Development
item.description: 5-10 GBP/hr | Create a CRM that will post cars for sale to multiple website at once, such as AutoTrader, eBay, GumTree, Facebook Marketplace, Friday Ad, Drive Mart for a car sales company.

item.title: Modernize & Maintain an E-Commerce Site
item.description:
25-50 CAD/hr | My current online store has grown dated, multiple plugins are obsolete and not functioning. I need it re-engineered into a clean, future-proof format and then kept running smoothly.
Priorities: • Completely refresh layout and navigation so shoppers find products in fewer clicks. • Apply a contemporary color palette and typography that matches current branding guidelines. • Replace imagery and graphics for more clear navigation • Inspect every existing plugin & extension, remove & replace what is obsolete, be sure nothing breaks in the process.
Once the rebuild is live, I’d like a lightweight maintenance plan in place—security patches, version updates, and quick fixes without my having to raise a ticket each time.
Deliverables will be considered complete when: 1. The revamped site goes live with no functional regressions. 2. All plugins/extensions show current versions and pass security scans. 3. Page-speed scores improve on both desktop and mobile benchmarks. 4. You supply a succinct post-launch hand-off document outlining update procedures and rollback points.
If you have questions about the existing codebase or need staging credentials, let me know and I’ll provide them right away.

item.title: Earn First $1K: Shopify Emails
item.description:
2-10 USD/hr | My Shopify dropshipping store is built, stocked, and sitting quietly—what it lacks is an email marketer who can turn subscribers into buyers. Your mission is simple: drive at least US $1,000 in verified store revenue strictly through email marketing. As soon as the dashboard shows that first $1,000, every cent of it is yours as payment. Note: The milestone payment will only be released after achieving this sales target as confirmed in Shopify analytics. If the target isn't met, a refund will be requested. After the milestone we can negotiate a longer-term arrangement if results stay strong.
Scope of work • Audit the store, connect your preferred platform (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, etc.), and be sure tracking is airtight. • Implement high-converting opt-ins so we grow the list quickly. • Build and launch three automated flows—Abandoned Cart, Welcome/Promo, and New-Product Announcements—complete with compelling copy, segmentation logic, and responsive design. • Tweak, A/B test, and refine until the $1K target shows up in Shopify analytics.
Acceptance criteria 1. All flows live and fully automated. 2. Revenue attribution inside Shopify (and the email dashboard) clearly shows at least US $1,000 generated from your campaigns. 3. A brief hand-off document summarising performance and next steps.
If email is your playground and you’re confident you can hit that first $1K fast, let’s get started.

item.title: Digital Product E-Commerce Website
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | I’m ready to launch an e-commerce site dedicated to selling digital products—think downloadable files, licenses, or resource packs—and I need a designer who can take it from concept to a polished, revenue-ready platform. The store has to feel clean and intuitive, work flawlessly on mobile, and, most importantly, feature a rock-solid secure payment gateway so my customers can pay with confidence. PayPal, Stripe, or a similarly trusted solution is fine as long as transactions remain fully encrypted and compliant.
I already have the product files prepared, so I’ll supply those assets along with branding guidelines. What I need from you is the complete front-end and back-end setup: modern UI/UX, product pages that showcase each file clearly, a streamlined checkout, and an admin area where I can add new digital items without touching code. If you suggest an established CMS (Shopify, WooCommerce, or comparable), let me know why it’s the best fit; a custom build is also on the table if it stays lightweight and secure.
Key deliverables: • Responsive e-commerce site tailored for digital downloads • Integration of a secure payment gateway with full testing • Admin dashboard for product, order, and download management • Basic documentation so I can handle routine updates myself
Propose your preferred tech stack, estimated timeframe, and any similar live projects you’ve completed. I’m ready to get started as soon as I find the right match.

item.title: WordPress & GHL Virtual Assistant -- 2
item.description:
2-8 CAD/hr | I’m looking for a tech-savvy virtual assistant who can jump straight into my WordPress sites, work confidently inside Elementor, and keep everything running smoothly while we scale. Day-to-day you’ll handle content updates, design tweaks, plugin housekeeping, and spin up new landing pages as ideas go live.
Beyond WordPress, you’ll also spend time inside GoHighLevel: maintaining CRM records, setting up marketing automations, and building or refining funnels so leads move seamlessly through the pipeline. Because I produce fresh campaigns regularly, you’ll both create new page and email content and keep existing assets current. Familiarity with Canva is a bonus—many of our graphics start there before heading to the site or funnel.
We’ll start part-time during onboarding and transition to full-time once you’re comfortable with the workflow. A short video interview will be required before we begin.
When you send your proposal, please answer: 1. Do you have experience in Canva? 2. Have you used Elementor as a website builder? 3. Have you used GoHighLevel (GHL)?
If you thrive on organized systems, enjoy creative problem-solving in WordPress and GHL, and are ready to grow with a busy digital team, I’d love to hear from you.

item.title: Website Optimisation for Digital Art Sales
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I run an online store that offers downloadable abstract art prints. The site is live, theproducts are uploaded, yet the buying journey still feels unfinished and traffic remains modest. I need a hand turning the current setup into a polished, sales-ready experience.
First, every print must be fully commerce-enabled. That means con firming product variants, pricing tiers and automatic delivery links, then wiring each item to a reliable checkout and shipping solution so a customer can buy, download or request physical fulfilment without friction.
Next comes presentation. I want visitors to explore the collection through interactive galleries, zoom into crisp high-resolution images and even preview pieces inside virtual art rooms. You are free to propose the best-fit plugins or custom code, but the end result should feel immersive and load quickly on desktop and mobile alike.
Purchasing should be flexible. Customers must be able to complete the order directly on my site while simultaneously giving me the option to list the same SKUs on an external marketplace. A single source of truth for inventory and order tracking is important, so any integration you implement (API, feed, or middleware) needs to keep everything in sync.
Visibility is the last piece. My goal is higher rankings and more qualified traffic, so the focus is on keyword optimisation and fresh, engaging content around each artwork and artistic theme. Well-structured meta tags, schema, alt text and a concise content plan will be key; backlink outreach is not required right now.
Deliverables • Fully configured product catalogue with seamless checkout and shipping • Interactive gallery, high-resolution zoom and virtual room preview deployed site-wide • Dual sales channel integration (website + chosen marketplace) with synced stock/status • On-page SEO overhaul: keyword mapping, titles, meta, alt text, schema plus a short content calendar • Brief hand-off guide so I can maintain listings and publish new prints in the same workflow
If you have recent experience in e-commerce UX, art-focused presentation tools and practical SEO, I’d love to see how you would approach this upgrade.

item.title: SEO Copy Update and Page Addition
item.description:
50+ USD/hr | I'm looking for an experienced SEO specialist to overhaul my website copy and add a few essential pages. The goal is to improve our SEO across the entire site to generate more leads and sales.
Key requirements: - Revise existing copy for SEO optimization - Add new pages: Services, Privacy, and Portfolio Update
Ideal skills and experience: - Proven SEO expertise - Strong copywriting skills - Experience in website structure and navigation for improved SEO - Ability to create engaging, sales-driven content

item.title: Freelance Pilates Instructor – Programme Creation (Remote, Task-Based)
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | Overview: I’m looking for a freelance instructor to create structured, progressive Pilates programmes for clients enrolled in a long-term coaching package. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the written and planning side of Pilates without any live teaching or client calls.
Responsibilities: • Create a full progressive Pilates plan based on client needs • Adapt the plan if required after reviewing client intake information • Deliver clear, accessible written instructions • Work independently and meet agreed deadlines
Requirements: • Pilates certification or relevant experience • Strong understanding of progression, alignment, and accessibility • Able to write clear, structured exercise plans • Reliable and organised
• Freelance/contract basis—no employment obligations
Ideal For: • Pilates instructors who enjoy programme design • Freelancers wanting flexible, task-based work • People who prefer written work over live teaching
How to Apply Please send your CV and a short message outlining your experience with Pilates programme design. You may include sample plans if you have them (optional).

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
